Definition: an Apharsekite or Apharsathkite, an unknown Assyrian tribe
BiblicalUsage: The Apharsathkites are named among the peoples who wrote to the king against the rebuilding of Jerusalem, and again among the officials beyond the river who were told to leave the work of God alone. Three verses, one role: they stand on the other side of the wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe their name is a small warning: opposition to God's work often comes dressed as official business. The wall went up anyway.
